messages:
Maria: quick sanity check before I merge this PR — it adds a few debug logs in inference-proxy to help investigate a 500 we saw in prod. posting snippets. can someone confirm we aren't leaking tokens / emails / full prompts?

Maria: PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-proxy/pull/1298|#1298> — main changes: request/response logging at DEBUG, header dump for tracing, and response.body logging when status >= 500.

Maria: example log line we produce locally: `{"req_id":"abc123","headers":{"authorization":"Bearer ***","x-user-email":"alex@example.com"},"request_body":"{\"prompt\":\"<LONG PROMPT>\"}","response_status":502}` — i masked auth in my local run but wanted to confirm prod behavior.

Aj: @Maria thanks — quick notes:
- we must never log raw `authorization` or `api_key` values; mask to 8 chars max or `REDACTED`.
- prompts are PII risk if users include names/emails — we usually redact full request body in prod unless opt-in.

Sasha: Looks like the PR uses `log.info(req.body)` in the error handler. can you switch to our scrub util `telemetry.scrubPayload(req.body, {allowFields: []})`? that will strip tokens, emails, and iterables > 4096 chars.

Maria: good call. i can swap to scrubPayload. question: if we scrub body, do we still need header dump? we use x-request-id for tracing.

Will: keep `x-request-id` and `x-correlation-id` but DO NOT log `authorization` or `cookie`. headers can be filtered with `redactHeaders(['authorization','cookie','set-cookie'])`. x-request-id okay.

Aj: also ensure telemetry tag `sensitivity: high` is set on that log so retention policy truncates it after 7 days and disables ingestion to demo dashboards.

Maria: got it — i'll: replace direct body logs with `telemetry.scrubPayload`, apply `redactHeaders`, add `sensitivity: high`. i'll push a follow-up commit.

Sasha: small nit — for error response bodies we prefer a summary: `error_summary` + `response_code` rather than full body. hackers sometimes return tokens in error messages.

Maria: ok switching to `error_summary = summarizeError(resp.body, 200)` and logging that.

sec-bot: audit note: flagged change for review by sec team. please @mention if you want an expedited review.

Will: would be good to run the smoke script against staging with `LOG_LEVEL=debug` to confirm masked output. command: `./scripts/smoke_inference.sh --env staging --sample 10` — check `logs/proxy.log` for no raw tokens.

Maria: running now, will paste sanitized sample in thread. thanks all :thumbsup:

Maria: pasted sample sanitized log: `{"req_id":"abc123","headers":{"x-request-id":"abc123"},"request_summary":"<REDACTED_PROMPT_LEN=512>","response_status":502,"error_summary":"upstream timeout"}` — looks clean to me.

Aj: :eyes: LGTM from me, just ensure CI linter for telemetry scrub is green.

Sasha: approved pending CI. Maria, add a short line in PR description about retention and sensitivity flag so infra can track.

Maria: will do and merge after CI. thanks everyone.
